MATHEMATICS ACTIVITIES — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #12
====

GRADE: PP2
SUBJECT: MATHEMATICS ACTIVITIES
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. In the number 3541, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 400
   B. 4
   C. 10
   D. 40

2. What is 8 × 5? (1 mark)
   A. 41
   B. 13
   C. 40
   D. 3

3. Solve for x: x + 4 = 12. (1 mark)
   A. 4
   B. 8
   C. 9
   D. 12

4. What is 8 × 9? (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 73
   C. 17
   D. 72

5. A square plot has side 6 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 12
   B. 24
   C. 36
   D. 42

6. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 5 cm and 12 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 13
   B. 17
   C. 15
   D. 7

7. What is the square of 9? (1 mark)
   A. 9
   B. 18
   C. 82
   D. 81

8. A square plot has side 9 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 36
   B. 81
   C. 90
   D. 18

9. What is 8 × 7? (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 56
   C. 57
   D. 15

10. What is 4 × 8? (1 mark)
   A. 12
   B. 33
   C. 4
   D. 32

11. What is the square of 5? (1 mark)
   A. 10
   B. 26
   C. 5
   D. 25

12. What is the square of 7? (1 mark)
   A. 49
   B. 50
   C. 14
   D. 7

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. Show full working: A trader sells 12 items at Ksh 60 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

14. Show full working: A trader sells 13 items at Ksh 65 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

15. Show full working: A trader sells 14 items at Ksh 70 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

16. Show full working: A trader sells 15 items at Ksh 75 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)
